resources.string: Blocks touches while you ride in the rain. When you lock, RainLock covers the screen with an invisible layer that swallows every touch, and listens for volume-down presses so you can unlock with the button. It does not read what is on your screen. With the adb permission, RainLock switches this on when you lock and off again when you unlock.
